stories.title: Man arrested for allegedly killing acquaintance over unpaid mobile loan
stories.summary: A man allegedly killed his 23-year-old acquaintance following a dispute over unpaid mobile loan instalments and dumped the body in bushes at a village in Navi Mumbai, police said on Wednesday. Officials said that the incident occurred last week. They also added that the accused, identified as Pratik Mohan Jadhav (30), a resident of Panvel in Navi Mumbai, was arrested on Monday, as per PTI.

stories.title: After 15-year delay, BMC clears 27 structures for road widening in Kandivali
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Tuesday demolished 27 structures that had been obstructing a long-pending road-widening project at the Mathuradas Road-Swami Vivekanand Road junction in Kandivali West. The demolition drive was carried out by the civic body's R-South Ward under its 'Pedestrian First' campaign, which aims to make footpaths more accessible to pedestrians by removing encroachments and clearing roads.

stories.title: Mumbai Shocker: 52-Year-Old Carpenter Injured After Passenger Hurls Knife At Fellow Commuter During Altercation On Train | Video

stories.summary: 5 lakh for individual weapons and sanctioning powers extending to ₹1 crore. The decision was taken at a Cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis. stories.title: Mumbai: Newborns at BMC hospitals to get birth certificates within three days
stories.summary: Newborns delivered at Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)-run hospitals will now receive their birth certificates within three days of registration, bringing relief to parents who earlier had to visit civic administrative offices to complete the process. BMC officials on Tuesday, November 17, announced that the birth certificates would be issued directly at the hospitals where the children are born.

stories.title: Salman Khan surprises Maatrubhumi cast and crew with luxury watches worth up to ₹6 lakh at Panvel farmhouse
stories.summary: Salman Khan recently gave the cast and crew of his upcoming film Maatrubhumi : May War Rest in Peace a reason to remember their time on the project. The actor hosted a get-together at his Panvel farmhouse on November 12, where he surprised the team with luxury Swiss watches.

stories.title: Mumbai’s First Underground Toilet-Cum-Art Gallery Planned at Kala Ghoda; BMC Approves ₹24-Crore Project
stories.summary: In a move to improve pedestrian movement and preserve the heritage character of South Mumbai, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation ( BMC ) has given in-principle approval to develop an underground public facility near Lion Gate in Kala Ghoda. Estimated to cost ₹24 crore, the proposed project will replace the existing Aspirational Toilet and Solid Waste Management (SWM) department chowkies with a 1,668-square-metre underground complex.

stories.title: Prince William Enjoys Bole Chudiyan Performance At Karan Johar’s Dharma Productions Office In Mumbai; Kareena Kapoor-Saif Ali Khan Join - Watch Videos

stories.title: Mumbai car dealer's trade certificate suspended over Ferrari delivery
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Transport Department has suspended the trade certificate of a Mumbai-based car dealer for 30 days for allegedly handing over a Ferrari to a customer before completing the vehicle’s registration, officials said on Wednesday. stories.title: Mumbai: Five bikers arrested for performing dangerous stunts on WEH
stories.summary: Mumbai Police have arrested five bikers for allegedly performing dangerous stunts, driving recklessly and creating a public nuisance on the Western Express Highway (WEH) . The royal couple is in India to attend the Earthshot Prize events and meet young environmental innovators from across the world. stories.title: Prince William & Kate Middleton Visit Chanakya School Of Craft In Mumbai's Lower Parel - VIDEO
stories.summary: Mumbai: Prince William and Kate Middleton visited the Chanakya School of Craft in Lower Parel on Wednesday, putting the spotlight on India's rich textile heritage and sustainable fashion. stories.title: Mumbai: Man arrested for demanding Rs 1 lakh from Nanded businessman
stories.summary: Police in Maharashtra's Nanded have arrested a man in Mumbai for allegedly demanding Rs 1 lakh from a businessman. stories.title: Missing three-year-old boy found dead in Andheri drain after three-day search
stories.summary: The body of a three-year-old boy, who had gone missing from the DN Nagar area on November 14, was found floating in a drain in Andheri West on Tuesday, bringing a tragic end to the search for the child. stories.title: Shivaji Maharaj’s Historic Vagh Nakh Goes on Display at Mumbai Museum
stories.summary: Mumbaikars can now witness the historic Vagh Nakh (tiger claw weapon) associated with Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and his legendary encounter with Afzal Khan in 1659. The centuries-old weapon has gone on public display at the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya (CSMVS) in South Mumbai as part of a special exhibition titled ‘Shivshastra Shauryagatha’.

stories.title: IndiGo aircraft grounded after bird hit at Navi Mumbai airport
stories.summary: An IndiGo flight from Mangaluru reported a bird hit on arrival at Navi Mumbai International Airport on Tuesday, following which the aircraft was grounded for inspection, a PTI source said. The bird struck the right side of the aircraft's fuselage, and the plane was taken out of service pending necessary checks, the source said.

stories.title: Torres Jewellery fraud: Ukrainian national Oleksandr Zapichenko extradited from Romania
stories.summary: Ukrainian national Oleksandr Zapichenko, 38, an accused in the Torres Jewellery fraud case, has been extradited to India, where he will stand trial for defrauding thousands of investors in Mumbai.
